invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$80.5（基于ATR 0.6486调整，入场价-2.1%），或融资费率Z-score转负（多头压力缓解），或Qlib评分跌至末位。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $80.5 (adjusted based on ATR 0.6486, entry -2.1%), or funding Z-score turns negative (long pressure eases), or Qlib score falls to bottom rank.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$0.089（基于ATR 0.0006调整，入场价-2.2%），或融资费率Z-score转负（多头压力缓解），或Qlib评分跌出前三。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $0.089 (adjusted based on ATR 0.0006, entry -2.2%), or funding Z-score turns negative (long pressure eases), or Qlib score falls out of top 3.
